Boosts both bass and treble while slightly pulling back the mids, forming a shallow V shape. Clear vocals and an airy top end.
Heavily boosted bass for a punchier kick, slightly pulled-back mids and a gently lifted treble.
A slight lift in bass and treble with recessed mids, giving a warm and mellow tone.
Low frequencies are pulled down to avoid muddiness, while treble harmonics and airiness are lifted to bring out the layering of orchestral music.
Lifts the bass for deeper low end and slightly tames the treble to avoid harshness, keeping the tone natural and smooth.
Restrained bass gain with slightly recessed mids, so the rhythm stays relaxed without booming.
Lifts bass and mids together, giving EDM kicks and synths more impact, with the treble slightly pulled back.
Solid and powerful bass and mids, with the treble slightly pulled back for a tight tone.
A gentle lift in bass and treble with slightly recessed mids, for a clean and bright sound.
